rows.quote: ObjectiveTo evaluate the association between genetically predicted GLP-1R expression and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and to explore potential mediation through JAKMIP3 and pulmonary-function traits using Mendelian randomization.MethodsWe conducted a two-sample drug-target cis-Mendelian randomization study using Genotype-Tissue Expression lung cis-expression quantitative trait locus summary data as genetic proxies for GLP-1R expression and FinnGen R5 summary data (1028 cases and 196,986 controls; n = 198,014) for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names an expression-QTL resource as the genetic proxy data; the dictionary has no row for it.
